sources.title: Study Guide for Exam DP-800: Developing AI-Enabled Database Solutions
sources.contentRelevance: The current official guide still explicitly measures the March 12, 2026 outline. Its three domains retain weights 35-40%, 35-40% and 25-30%, with 11 skills and 73 subskills. The refreshed extraction has no objective-content change. This establishes scope, not technical correctness or feature availability.

sources.title: Develop AI-enabled database solutions
sources.contentRelevance: The current DP-800T00-A course covers SQL Server, Azure SQL and SQL databases in Fabric. It is an ancestry-only preparation bridge: current credential HTML references its exact course UID, and current course HTML references the three self-paced path UIDs. The overview is not technical evidence for answers.

parents.evidenceSummary: The current official credential HTML contains data-learn-uid="course.dp-800t00" in its Learning Paths preparation container. The separately retrieved canonical course identifies itself as Course DP-800T00-A and links back to this credential.

sources.title: Design and develop database solutions
sources.contentRelevance: The current self-paced path links four modules for database objects, programmability, advanced T-SQL and AI-assisted SQL development. It supplies the finite preparation ancestry for the first domain. Exact implementation claims require the linked teaching units and their directly referenced product documentation.

parents.relevanceJustification: The exact matching UID and canonical path bind this course reference to the actual self-paced design path, rather than inferring approval from a similar title, hostname or subject.

sources.contentRelevance: The current self-paced path links the models and embeddings, intelligent search, and RAG modules. Its overview names Azure SQL Database and T-SQL AI workflows but does not establish maturity or exact API behavior. Supporting units and directly referenced product articles remain necessary.
